summary_en: 16,000,000 shares (1.4% of shares outstanding), ¥20.0 billion upper limit, execution window 6 August – 30 November 2026. Method: open market. Rationale: improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: On 5 August 2026, Yokohama Financial Group's board approved the acquisition of up to 16,000,000 of its own shares (1.4% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) within a ¥20.0 billion ceiling. The acquisition period runs from 6 August to 30 November 2026 and will be conducted via open-market purchase. The company stated the rationale is to improve capital efficiency in light of current business performance and capital levels.
